description.value: Platform 7 Coffee is an atmospheric specialty café with two Vancouver locations — one in Kitsilano and one in East Vancouver — each designed to evoke Victorian London and Belle-Époque Parisian train stations. The café runs a full espresso bar, a brew bar featuring single-origin coffees via V60, Chemex, AeroPress, and siphon, plus cold brew, nitro, and an artisan ice cream bar. A substantial food menu of sandwiches, wraps, baked goods, and protein snacks makes it a practical mid-ride stop with both indoor and outdoor seating.
